name: Jönköping University
summary: 16,000 students in Jönköping, 2,700 of them international, with a triple-accredited business school (JIBS); IB students can apply on predicted grades.

ib.text: Its own IB table: English B SL meets English 6; Maths AA SL at 3 or AI SL at 4 meets Maths 3c; sciences at 4. Final-year IB students get conditional offers on predicted grades via JU Direct.

dates.label: JU Direct Application closes (programmes may fill earlier)

programmes.name: Bachelor in International Economics
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL at 3 or AI SL at 4.
programmes.about: A shared first year in business and economics, then international trade, financial markets and econometrics with large datasets and AI-supported analysis; a semester abroad or internship in year three.

needs.note: AI SL at grade 4 also counts.

programmes.selectionNote: JU Direct: rolling admission on IB predicted grades, with a letter of motivation; programmes can fill and close before 2 May 2027, so apply early.

programmes.name: Bachelor in International Management
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL at 3 or AI SL at 4.
programmes.about: A shared first year in business and economics, then international management: entrepreneurship, leadership, strategy, change and supply chains, with a semester abroad or an internship.

needs.note: AI SL at grade 4 also counts.

programmes.selectionNote: JU Direct: rolling admission on IB predicted grades, with a letter of motivation; programmes can fill and close before 2 May 2027, so apply early.

programmes.name: Bachelor in International Marketing
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL at 3 or AI SL at 4.
programmes.about: A shared first year in business and economics, then marketing: consumer behaviour, branding, digital marketing, market research and SEO, with data-driven tools and a semester abroad option.

needs.note: AI SL at grade 4 also counts.

programmes.selectionNote: JU Direct: rolling admission on IB predicted grades, with a letter of motivation; programmes can fill and close before 2 May 2027, so apply early.

programmes.name: Graphic Design and Web Development
programmes.ib: Maths AI SL at grade 3 or any higher IB Maths.
programmes.about: Graphic design, programming and web design combined with digital marketing and UX design: you learn to design and code interactive web applications and to make graphics for print and screen.
programmes.selectionNote: JU Direct: rolling admission on IB predicted grades, with a letter of motivation; programmes can fill and close before 2 May 2027, so apply early.

programmes.name: Industrial Engineering and Management: Sustainable Supply Chain Management
programmes.ib: Maths at Swedish Maths 3b level: Maths AA SL at 3 or AI SL at 4.
programmes.about: Industrial economics and organisation focused on sustainable supply chains: logistics, purchasing, lean, quality management, transport, warehousing and simulation.

needs.note: AI SL at grade 4 also counts.

programmes.selectionNote: JU Direct: rolling admission on IB predicted grades, with a letter of motivation; programmes can fill and close before 2 May 2027, so apply early.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering (BSc)
programmes.ib: Physics and Chemistry at grade 4, and Maths AA SL at 3 or AI SL at 4.
programmes.about: Mechanical engineering, materials and product development, designing complex systems in teams from day one with CAD, simulation and real industry challenges.

needs.note: AI SL at grade 4 also counts.

programmes.selectionNote: JU Direct: rolling admission on IB predicted grades, with a letter of motivation; programmes can fill and close before 2 May 2027, so apply early.

programmes.name: Prosthetics and Orthotics, BSc
programmes.ib: Physics and Chemistry at grade 4, and Maths AA SL at 3 or AI SL at 4 (national listing: Physics 2, Chemistry 1, Maths 3c).
programmes.about: Train as a prosthetist and orthotist: medical knowledge, technology and patient work combined to design and fit prostheses and orthoses, moving from classroom to clinic.

needs.note: AI SL at grade 4 also counts.

programmes.selectionNote: JU Direct: rolling admission on IB predicted grades, with a letter of motivation; programmes can fill and close before 2 May 2027, so apply early.

notes: JU says final-year school students can apply only through JU Direct, with grades up to the first half of the final year; you must send final IB results before term starts.
Admission is rolling, and a programme can close before 2 May 2027 once it is full.
To keep a conditional offer you must complete all subjects and keep the points of your predicted grades, JU's IB section says.
